headline: In Brief
text:
In Brief

Residents packed the meeting room, many carrying signs and asking for more detail about how the money would be spent. For now, the practical effect is modest: a handful of new signs, a revised schedule and a promise to revisit the issue in the fall. Construction crews closed two lanes of the bridge for most of the afternoon, causing delays across the city. Officials said the plan would take effect next spring, though several members warned that the timeline could slip again.
